children.name: Ribes mandshuricum  Kom.
children.description:
낙엽성 관목. 높이 1.5-3m. 잎 마주나기, 털이 없거나 잔털만 있거나 융모를 이루기도 하며 종이질 쪽은 약간 두텁고 타원형에서 피침형, 또는 타원상달걀형, 긴예두, 짧은예두, 또는 둔두, 난상 둔저 또는 예저, 크기는(2.5)4×7(10)-2×3(4.5)cm, 잎맥은 일차맥이 각각 4×6(8)개이다. 잎자루는 길이 2× 3(4.5)mm로 털이 있다. 꽃 원추꽃차례는 새가지 끝에 달리며 크기는 1.5×4 × 1.5×2.5cm이다. 꽃자루의 길이는 0×2mm. 꽃받침은 1.5×2mm. 꽃잎은 5×11mm이다. 꽃부리통은 수술보다 갈라진 부분보다 두 배 길다. 수술은 갈라진 꽃잎의 2/3 지점까지 올라오며 꽃밥은 길이 3mm로 피침형이다. 열매 및 종자 원형에 가깝거나 원형, 5×10 × 5×8mm,검은색으로 익는다.

children.name: Ribes maximowiczianum Kom.
children.description:
낙엽성 교목. 높이 20m. 굵은 가지가 나와서 퍼진다. 겨울눈 및 소지 반원형, 원추형이고 작다,. 아린은 4-6개, 가정아와 측아는 모두 작다(길이 1mm이하). 새가지는 녹색, 피목(껍질눈)이 산재, 군데군데에 자갈색의 얇은 막이 벗겨지고 소지같은 편평한 가시가 존재(5cm 이상)한다. 잎자국은 짧은T자형이다. 잎 어긋나기, 길이 12-22cm, 1-2회 깃털형겹잎, 소엽은 5-8쌍, 찌그러진 달걀상타원형 또는 긴타원형, 무딘형 원저, 3-5.5cm, 9.5cm × 3cm, 가장자리에 파상의 톱니가 있다. 2회 깃털형겹잎은 4쌍의 잎과 5-7쌍의 소엽이 달리며 엽축 표면에 홈이 있고 다소 날개같이 된다. 꽃 잡성암수한그루, 지름 6mm, 연한 녹색, 총상꽃차례이다. 꽃받침잎과 꽃잎은 각각 5개, 수술은 9-10개, 길이 4-5mm, 녹
색, 수술대에 털이 있다. 열매 및 종자 꼬투리는 비틀려서 꼬이며 23cm × 3cm이다.

children.name: Ribes sericeum Eastw.
children.description: Ribes sericeum is a species of currant known by the common name Lucia gooseberry, or Santa Lucia gooseberry; its Latin epithet of sericeum means "of silk".

children.name: Ribes setchuense Jancz.
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Sichuan, SE. Gansu). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes sinanense F.Maek.
children.description: The native range of this species is Japan (C. Honshu). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes soulieanum Jancz.
children.description: The native range of this species is Tibet to China (NW. Yunnan). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes speciosum Pursh
children.description: Ribes speciosum is a species of flowering plant in the family Grossulariaceae, which includes the edible currants and gooseberries.

children.name: Ribes steinbachiorum Weigend & Binder
children.description: The native range of this species is Bolivia. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the montane tropical biome.

children.name: Ribes stenocarpum Maxim.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. & E. Qinghai to China (Gansu, Shaanxi, NW. Sichuan). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes sucheziense Jancz.
children.description: The native range of this species is Bolivia. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the montane tropical biome.

children.name: Ribes sylvestre F.Dietr.
children.description: The native range of this species is Chile (Valparaíso). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes takare D.Don
children.description: The native range of this species is Himalaya to C. China and N. Myanmar. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes tenue Jancz.
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & EC. China. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes thacherianum  Munz
children.description: Ribes thacherianum, with the common name Santa Cruz gooseberry, or Santa Cruz Island gooseberry, is a rare North American species of currant found only on the island of Santa Cruz off the coast of California.

children.name: Ribes tianquanense S.H.Yu & J.M.Xu
children.description: The native range of this species is China (W. Sichuan). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes tolimense Cuatrec.
children.description: The native range of this species is Colombia (Tolima, Cauca). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the montane tropical biome.

children.name: Ribes tortuosum Benth.
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico (Baja California). It grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Ribes trilobum Meyen
children.description: Ribes trilobum, commonly known as parrilla and muhul, is a species of flowering plant in the family Grossulariaceae.

children.name: Ribes triste Pall.
children.description: Ribes triste, known as the northern redcurrant, swamp redcurrant, or wild redcurrant, is an Asian and North American shrub in the gooseberry family.

children.name: Ribes tumerec Weigend & Breitkopf
children.description: The native range of this species is Peru. It grows primarily in the montane tropical biome.

children.name: Ribes turbinatum Pojark.
children.description: The native range of this species is Kazakhstan. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes valdivianum Phil.
children.description: The native range of this species is Chile (Los Lagos) to Argentina (Neuquén). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes viburnifolium A.Gray
children.description: Ribes viburnifolium, is an uncommon North American species in the gooseberry family.

children.name: Ribes victoris Greene
children.description: Ribes victoris is an uncommon North American species of currant known by the common name Victor's gooseberry.

children.name: Ribes vilmorinii Jancz.
children.description: The native range of this species is China (W. Sichuan, NW. Yunnan, Hubei). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes viridiflorum  L.T.Lu & G.Yao
children.description: The native range of this species is China (N. Zhejiang). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Ribes watsonianum Koehne
children.description: Ribes watsonianum is a North American species of currant known by the common names spring gooseberry and wild gooseberry, found in the US states of Washington and Oregon.

children.name: Ribes weberbaueri Jancz.
children.description: The native range of this species is Peru. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the montane tropical biome.

children.name: Ribes xizangense L.T.Lu
children.description: The native range of this species is Tibet. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Grossularia
children.description: Grossularia — a genus of magnoliopsidas.
